_hinweis: Schiedsrichter (17.11., Chris: 'hud Effekte und schiri auch über Pixel lab' -- Freigabe fuer genau diese eine neue Figur). Index-Schluessel __schiri (kein Spieler). Neu exportieren: PIXELLAB_API_KEY=... python3 -I scripts/figuren-sprites-export.py --nur __schiri

figur.quelle: api.pixellab.ai /v2/create-character-pro (method create_with_style, template custom, view low top-down, 80x80)
figur.prompt: Referee, a sports official of race Human. A fit, average-build adult man with short dark hair, clean-shaven, neutral calm face. He wears a short-sleeved referee shirt with bold vertical black and white stripes (wide, high-contrast stripes clearly visible on chest, back and sleeves), black trousers, black sneakers, a thin black belt. A shiny silver whistle hangs on a black cord around his neck. No hat, no weapon, no armour, no cape. Upright neutral standing pose, arms relaxed at his sides, feet shoulder-width apart. Full body pixel art character.

pfiff.action_description: quickly raises one arm straight up high above his head with an open hand to signal a foul while putting the whistle to his mouth and blowing it, then holds the arm up
pfiff.jobs_hinweis: north: Nachbestellung 17.11. an dieselbe Gruppe (1 Gen. angesetzt); Job-ID aus der Bestellantwort (schiri_jobs.json)

lizenz: PixelLab-Abonnement (Tier 3), eigene Erzeugung fuer dieses Projekt

walk.action_description: walks forward with a steady stride, arms swinging naturally, then returns to the starting pose
walk.freigabe: Chris 17.11.: eine Schiri-Figur samt Animationen/Gesten ist genehmigt (kein Muster fuer andere Figuren)
